Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** all production regions to v2.3.0. Verified afterward: the service is now healthy with an error rate of 0.2%.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api, documenting the failing v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged.
